result.title: Scalable Beckmann Maps Improve One-step Generation
result.comment: 40 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://tullebulle.github.io/projects/sbm/
result.summary: Beckmann Transport Models (BTM) learn one-step generative maps end-to-end from data, without a teacher, a distillation stage, or pretrained features. We introduce Scalable Beckmann Maps (SBM), which bring to BTM the two ingredients behind the quality of modern multistep generators: classifier-free guidance (CFG) and a training recipe that scales, while keeping sampling at a single network evaluation. CFG combines conditional and unconditional velocity or score predictions, which a Beckmann map does not have. Our guidance rests on one observation: the BTM current is a positive multiple of an autonomous denoising field, to which CFG applies as it does to a velocity. With exact denoisers this gives guided BTM. In practice we substitute the map's own conditional and null predictions for the denoisers, which requires no additional network and introduces a bias that we characterize. We show that the guided update is consistent with a guided conservation equation, and that guidance can move the boundaries between basins, sending more noise to the modes a condition favors. Trained from scratch in the latent of a representation autoencoder, SBM reaches a one-step FID of 1.6 on ImageNet 256x256 without a teacher or a feature loss, outperforming the Improved-MeanFlow baseline with 3.2x fewer FLOPs. In text-to-image generation it reaches a GenEval score of 0.86 with one network evaluation. As a world model, where we train without guidance, the recipe alone outperforms DriftWorld on all five metrics of two robot-manipulation benchmarks, with 1.9-2.8x less training compute and no pretrained auxiliary feature encoder.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Scalable Beckmann Maps，为 Beckmann 传输模型引入无分类器引导（CFG）和可扩展训练配方，在表示自编码器的 latent 中从零训练，实现仅需单次网络评估的一步生成，并用于文生图与机器人操作世界模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把多步迭代生成动力学摊销进单次前向、并分析引导如何移动吸引域边界的思路，可能为多步 latent 推理的少步/一步摊销及条件信号对状态收敛区域的影响提供可核查线索，但与 VLM 推理本身无直接联系。
